A type of dark [[Color/Legends|green]] '''lichen''' that developed from [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] grew in the rift valleys of the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]]. The lichen developed whenever its seeds found themselves out of the wind and with a reliable source of [[Water/Legends|water]], despite such circumstances sometimes taking [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] to arise on Maya Kovel.<ref name="Endor">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref>
